title: THIS BLUE BIRD DIGS A SECRET RIVER TUNNEL
caption: A tiny blue fishing bird builds its nest inside a riverbank. 🐟💙 #Kingfisher #BirdFacts #Wildlife #NatureFacts #WildVox

narration_timeline.text: A flash of electric blue crosses the river, then vanishes underwater. That's the common kingfisher, a tiny bird that hunts fish from a perch.
narration_timeline.scene: Reveal the kingfisher and its fish-hunting perch as the hook is spoken

narration_timeline.text: It spots prey, dives headfirst, and often returns holding a slippery catch.
narration_timeline.scene: Show fishing/diving behavior while the narration describes the catch

narration_timeline.text: Before swallowing, it may strike the fish against a branch.
narration_timeline.scene: Keep the visual on a kingfisher handling a fish

narration_timeline.text: Its nest isn't built in a tree. Kingfishers dig a tunnel into a steep riverbank and raise their chicks inside.
narration_timeline.scene: Switch to riverbank/nesting visuals exactly when the narration changes to the nest

narration_timeline.text: So the next time you see blue streak past a stream,
narration_timeline.scene: Return to an active kingfisher by the stream

narration_timeline.text: look for a nearby bank: that tiny bird may have a hidden tunnel home.
